voiceover:
[excited, conversational] Okay, so Google just beat GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 on a benchmark. [curious] It's called Gemini 4 Carbon, and that's according to Google's own numbers. It scored 59 on the AA Index v5.0, a general AI test, just ahead of both rivals.

[excited, fast] Google says Carbon nearly sweeps categories like agentic coding and science and math. But the big flex is cybersecurity. Google claims it finds vulnerabilities and fixes the root cause. [surprised] It's also twice as likely to write secure code compared to Argon, which launched two weeks ago.

[serious] Here's the catch. You can't use it yet. It goes to select cybersecurity defense companies first, then trusted partners, then a wide release.

[confident] So if you code or work in security, watch this one.

[playful, warm] Send this to the developer friend who says their code is always perfectly secure.
